THE FLAGSHIP LIFTS — slowly the great flagship rises from its mast, steam-whistle blowing long and low, mooring-lines falling away into the crowd below.
LINES AWAY — the last mooring-line drops free and the flagship climbs, its hull catching the light as the dock-platform dwindles.
FOG DEPARTURE — a vast liner rises through the drifting harbor-fog, running-lights glowing amber, the waving crowd dissolving into grey beneath her keel.
THE FLEET ANSWERS — as the flagship sounds her whistle, every vessel in the harbor answers, the whole sky filling with echoing steam-cries.
CAST OFF — a great burst of released steam billows white from the flagship's funnels as she casts off and begins her slow climb skyward.
GOLDEN ASCENT — the ship rises into a burning golden sunset, the harbor and its tiny waving figures dwindling to a smear of warm light below.
HATS AND STEAM — a fireworks-free send-off of thrown hats, swinging lanterns, and great white plumes of steam rising together into the evening air.
THE SLOW TURN — the flagship turns slowly over the docks, her vast hull rotating against the clouds, the crowd below following her with upturned faces.
MAST DEPARTURE — the great liner lifts from her mooring-mast with a long whistle-cry, ropes trailing, the platform crowd waving until she clears the upper gantries.
RISING THROUGH CLOUD — she climbs through the low harbor-cloud and emerges into clear sky above, whistles still sounding, the docks invisible beneath the grey.
THE SEND-OFF — hats swing, lamps sway, steam billows; no fireworks needed when a flagship of this size lifts slowly into the evening sky.
WHISTLE AND WAKE — the flagship's whistle blows three long notes and the fleet echoes back, a chorus of steam rising across the whole harbor basin.
FOG AND LIGHT — running-lights burn gold through the harbor-fog as the liner climbs, her outline softening until only the whistle-sound remains below.
MOORING-LINES FALLING — one by one the mooring-lines release, snaking downward through the air, and the flagship begins her long slow rise from the mast.
ABOVE THE DOCKS — the flagship clears the upper dock-gantries and swings her bow toward open sky, the crowd a sea of waving arms far below.
STEAM FAREWELL — great white clouds of released steam pour from the flagship's sides as she lifts, a billowing farewell visible across the whole harbor.
SUNSET HARBOR — the harbor dwindles below, lamps and platforms and waving figures shrinking as the ship climbs into the wide golden light of evening.
THE FLEET SALUTES — every whistle in the harbor sounds at once as the flagship departs, steam rising from a dozen vessels in ceremonial answer.
SLOW ASCENT — she rises slowly, deliberately, the crowd below growing small, the great hull turning against a sky still pale with the last of the day.
LAMPS AND STEAM — swinging dock-lamps and rolling steam-clouds mark her going, the crowd pressing to the platform rail as the flagship's shadow passes over them.
THE LAST LINE — the final mooring-line drops and a cheer goes up from the platform, the flagship already climbing, whistle singing, into the open sky.
HARBOR FAREWELL — the harbor spreads wide below her as she rises, the mooring-masts and steam-cranes and waving crowds arranged like a map beneath her keel.
INTO THE GOLD — she passes into the golden band of sunset and her hull blazes briefly copper before the sky deepens and she dwindles into it.
THE CROWD WATCHES — every face on the platform tilts upward as the flagship rises, hats waving, lamps swinging, the whistle-cry rolling back across the harbor.
DEPARTURE COMPLETE — the flagship clears the harbor-fog and sets her course, whistles fading behind her, the docks and their waving crowds already far below.
